what: MACHAMP unattended loop, generations 6 onward (solver/machamp/loop_sprt.js). Written 2026-09-25 BEFORE generation 6's first self-play game. Every generation runs the round-3 recipe (solver/machamp/preregistration-r3.json) unchanged except where stated here.

per_generation_n.selfplay: the champion plays 1,000 games (seed 200 + n) in the league { current: champion 0.6, previous: previous champion 0.2, human clone 0.2 } on TRAIN pairs of data/team-pool-frozen-regmc; MILTANK k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, 1000 ms, depth 0; 3 workers -> solver/out/selfplay/eaa5becc54eb/loop-sp<n>
per_generation_n.deep_values: deep_value.js on every pooled directory that has none yet (4 rollouts x 3 turns of DODUO-v1 play, frozen PORYGON2 v0 leaf, seed n); a replay mismatch stops the loop
per_generation_n.pool: every self-play directory on this release: gen0, gen1, r2-sp0, r2-sp1, r3-sp0 and each loop-sp<k>, unweighted
per_generation_n.training: exactly gen5's: MAG/DODUO from MAG v1 + DODUO v1 with beta 0.7 and human weight 3.0; PORYGON2 from v0 on 0.5 z + 0.5 v_deep (human positions 1:1); torch seed n; 4 threads

gates.G_pory2_human: 95% upper bound of (new - PORYGON2 v0) held-out human log-loss <= +0.004
gates.G_beats_previous: SPRT vs the CURRENT champion: elo0 0, elo1 +20, alpha = beta = 0.05, pair scores, index order, <= 2,000 games, battle seed 9001 + 10 (n - 5), 3 workers; PASS iff H1
gates.G_not_lose_clone: 200 games vs the human clone (battle seed 9002 + 10 (n - 5)); Wilson 95% upper bound >= 0.5
gates.accept: all three pass; the candidate becomes the champion and the old champion becomes 'previous'

per_generation_n.publish: accepted: models + spec + CHANGELOG-REGMC + RUNNING-NOTES rows (a MINOR above main's top) + one solver/LOG.md line + a section in docs/_reports/2026-09-25-machamp-loop.md, pushed to origin main after merging it (never forced). Rejected: the solver/LOG.md line and the report section only; the rejected models stay untracked.

stop: two consecutive generations that fail the SPRT; or the file solver/out/machamp/STOP; or any error
